values.note: Town of Madawaska: $35 the first night, $25 each additional, $125 a week, $200 two weeks, $375 a month. The page itself carries no year (site footer 2023).

fees.source: https://townofmadawaska.com/town_meetings/visitor_info/st_john_river_campground.php ('First Night Rental $ 35.00'; 'Additional Nights $ 25.00'; 'Weekly Price $ 125.00'; 'Two Week Price $ 200.00'; 'Monthly Price $ 375.00'), read 2026-11-02

note: Town of Madawaska's St. John River Campground, 102 Public Works Ave, on the St. John River. Register and pay at the Madawaska Police Dept, 428 Main St, before setting up. Check-in 11a-8p. --Claude
summary: Confirmed town-run, 8 sites, $35 first night then $25, phone. Page says nothing on hookups or season. Riverfront looks right on imagery.
flags: PUBLIC NIGHTS: yes. The town's page sells first-night, weekly and monthly rates to 'All persons entering the campground', who register at the police department. No residents or event-only limit stated.

HOOKUPS NOT WRITTEN (town page silent), reviews only: Google 4 stars, 2 months ago: 'There are 8 spots with 2 50 amp full hookups and the rest 30 amps. Rests rooms close by but no showers. Picnic tables and fire ring. Beautiful view!'; Google 5 stars, 4 years ago: 'There are 8 RV sites at this location with full hook-ups that we camped at.' If you accept a dated camper report here, that is electric 50, water, sewer, showers false.

WATERFRONT LEAD, riverfront stored, supported, not changed: imagery at the pin shows a herringbone of gravel pads whose tips end about 15-50 m from the bank, across rough grass with a thin band of brush at the top of the bank. The St. John is well over 100 m wide. The town's boat landing road runs down the east side of the loop, not between pads and river. A Google reviewer says 'Beautiful view!' If the brush band reads as a screen, the value would be riverview; no pad-level photo read.
RATE DATE: no year on the town's rate list; site footer says 2023. Read live 2026-11-02. Google reviewer 9 years ago: 'Overnight campers allowed at a very nice fee'.

NAME: town's page says 'St John River Campground'. Town nav also says 'St. John River Campground, Boat Launch'. No change needed. Google: 4.8 from 17 reviews, listed mainly as a boat landing; no website or phone in that panel. Season not stated by the town.
PIN OK: crosshair sits at the east end of the pad loop, under 100 m from the pads.
